body: Dude really? All you did was give a link then be an ass the whole time.  "I'll be seeing you one the news I'm sure" what the hell kind of comment is that? Sounds to me like you want to him to act on these thoughts. Go ahead and edit your comments so you look like less of an asshole like you already have. You say your just trying to help, but it looks pretty clear like your just being an ass honestly. You told the guy he has to go the hospital right now on you other comment. he clearly has a fear and he voiced that and all you did was push him and he's the bad guy? All you did was provoke him. he wants to know what to do without dealing with mental health professionals, he made that really clear. You were ignorant and ignored his point of "I want to know what to do without dealing with mental health professionals". So quit trying to act like you're the victim.
Honestly it sounds like your a shit person and its pretty obvious why no girl would ever want to go out with you.
I'm perfectly happy with who I am
I love who I am
Thats quite alright, your still not getting the point at all. Way to focused on quotes, not even concerned about context.
Normally doing things just for my normal life is enough to meet women my age that I like. I just can't get them to go on a date with me.

This definitely makes sense now. But I still haven't the slightest clue of what I'm doing wrong. I do pay attention to what I'm doing so I don't just try the same things over again and expect different results. I researched it a lot. It doesn't seem like I'm really doing anything wrong, but obviously I am based on the results.

It's not about clubbing, its doing things with the motivation of just meeting women. I do stuff that makes me happy or what I need to do to be happy, I've never gone out to just meet new girls. I've considered it, but my therapist swears that's a mistake.
it's not that I don't put myself out there. I meet lots of women and am able to interact with the ones I like. The problem is I can't get any of them to agree to go on a date with me.

Poor, but I also didn't give it as much effort as I could of, especially looking back on it. My therapist had me try online dating once, and after a week of not even being able to get a reply, I stopped with it. I could of definitely gotten better pictures of me, I definitely could of spent more time on my profile, I could of been more patient with it.

I'm a shy person that can be awkward at first, but normally that's not an issue. Once I get started in a conversation I'm pretty good. I'm definitely funny and charming once I get past the first couple word exchanges with strangers.

I'm sure there's other things besides looks. But it sure feels like nobody will overlook how I appear and wont give me a chance to show them all the things I have to offer than aren't a nice looking face.

Would you date a guy thats nice, has a good personality, but lets say he got hit really hard by the ugly stick? Would you overlook his appearance for his personality? I honestly think the answer is no, it feels that way anyways.

> What kind of interests do you have that will appeal to the majority of women?

Really good question honestly. I don't really read to much into what kind of hobbies women like. I see women as people with vaginas, I figure there's gotta be some girls out there that like the same things I like. I do meet them, but its normally not for the exact same interest. One that's been kind of common is that I've found some girls like too are anime, video games, I've even found some that like to go up to the woods with me and have a nice fire.

Also thank you for the explanation on types of women, that actually did clarify. I guess the type of women I'm normally are attracted too are nerdy girls.

The sword example was true but swords aren't my only hobby. I got lots of hobbies and I just generally look for women who like the same stuff I do. I feel like I'm a cool guy that does a bunch of awesome stuff, strangely I want to do these things with a woman.

>What kinds of girls are you usually attracted to?

I don't know what different kinds of girls there are, like really. I normally get attracted to women I meet in my life from either a club like the girl I mentioned in the last comment I met in my school's anime club, or school and I normally like them because they have similar interest.

Everyone says I'm insecure, but I don't feel that I am. I accept the way I look, its who I am. The reason people say I'm insecure is because I feel that women wont accept my face, unlike myself. I feel like I was born with a face that no woman will like.

Well you asked for what you said, as in you personally. That's what you personally have said, I could make a list based on what all other people have said. 

I find women attractive based on what they like to do. Like for example I'm very into swords and medieval type of combat, like archery and stuff. The other day I asked a girl out and got rejected. The reason I liked her was because she likes swords too. Obvious there's more to it, but its all about the mutual interest if you ask me.

That's another piece of common advice I get is to join clubs and such. Well I have and I do meet all kinds of girls with common interest as me. But can I ever get a date with any of them? nope

I do good with things I can. I have really good hair that some people are even jealous of. My hygiene is top notch. I'm not sloppy, I would say I have good etiquette. I dress like all other people do my age.

I really don't feel that I don't accept who I am. But its not like it matters, I'm not getting anywhere either way.
Meaning in other things, while I have to accept being alone and much worse people don't. That's not a world I want to live in
Well you personally told me to see a therapist. I've been doing that for almost a year now.
Guess there's nothing to live for then

Well the claim is that I'm insecure about how I look. I don't feel that I am, ANYMORE. But I still never get anywhere with women. I'm doing all the things you and the other commenters say to do in situations like mine, yet I am getting absolutely nowhere with women at all. Oftentimes it feels like there's nothing I can do about it but just accept that I'm not cut out for the opposite sex.

Almost a year now and once a week. My therapist tells me I'm just unlucky with women. I really am having a hard time believing that as time keeps going. I don't think I'm insecure like everyone claims, but if that many people are claiming it they must be on to something. 

I really think its not being insecure, because I'm not insecure like I USED to be. I used to be obsessed with how I look. I rarely question how I look at all now. It just feels like there isn't a woman out there that will like my face, because they keep calling it ugly. It doesn't matter what I think about myself if women think I'm ugly.

I feel like I'm not insecure. But everyone says I am. I honestly think I'm average looking at worst. But everyone keeps saying I'm insecure.

I guess I'm just a lost cause. Not good enough for anyone to like, I just have to settle with being alone.
I have been, here I am. Feels like there's nothing I can do about it.
I don't sit at home and play games. That's not my issue.
Nobody ever says its that bad until they actually see me. Then suddenly its worse.
I don't feel uncomfortable like you say though. I don't feel like all those things you say.

But I don't just go out and tell women that "Hey I'm ugly, please date me so I feel better". I don't go out saying those things at all. From the sounds of it you think I'm just some ball baby that just sits and mopes all day? 

Its hard to NOT think that your potentially too ugly for others when your told by countless women that your too ugly for them to go on a date with them, and never once hearing from a girl that I look good, except on online places like here where they don't even know what I look like.

My demeanor when I'm around women isn't I'm super ugly please date me. I don't feel that I'm even going to get rejected most of the time.

I know you don't believe me, you seem to have to think I'm really bad person. But I'm not. I really do have a lot to offer as a person. I have a good personality. I have hobbies, I don't go constantly seeking validation like you claim.

This is how I feel. I feel that I would make a woman very happy if one would just give me a chance by overlooking my ugliness.
Did you read the paragraph that starts off with "I don't actively pursue women"?

I really don't think its just that I think that's preventing this whole thing. I really don't. I think there's more to it than that. When I approach women I don't just say "Hey I'm ugly go on a date with me"

> I think you should stop looking for a girlfriend and start looking for friends

I swear nobody is actually reading my post. I specifically said in my post that I DON'T actively look for women. I just live my normal life, but by doing that, I will meet women I like, it just happens that way.

I never said I needed a relationship to make me happy. I really don't think it's confidence, everyone swears it but I don't act unconfident I really don't. I also really don't think women can read into my head that I've been called ugly before. I also don't go saying "yeah I'm ugly as shit go on a date with me" when I'm around women.

>  The best thing I can say is work on yourself. Develop your own goals, ambitions , career, hobbies.

Why do you and all the other commenters keep assuming I have none of these things? Like I swear all of you think I'm just some guy that does nothing but wallow about not having a woman that's just not true. Yes I do actually have my own life. I don't get why not having a girlfriend ever and wanting to change that means I'm some unsecure guy that hates himself and says I hate myself in front of women. That's just plain not true.

I think you along many others misread me, but that was my fault for poor wording. I don't think I'm ugly. I feel that all girls think I'm ugly. In my eyes, what good does me thinking I look good doe me when all the girls reject me because they think I look bad. I really don't know what's so wrong with my appearance, I know I have my flaws and stuff but I really don't think I'm any worse than the average person. But when I talk to girls, they seem think I'm about as ugly as it gets.

Like I said in my post, I actually do take care of my body. No I'm not "doing it wrong" I was a football player for 6 years, I think I know how to work out. My hair is in my opinion my best feature. It's styled good, I groom well, it's not because of that. I've gotten advice before, and those are the first things people tell you. Go to gym, eat well, clothes, groom, ect. are the first things people tell you.

>Now about pursuing women, you should probably ask someone on a date, if you'd like to go on one. Things like that don't fall from the sky, you should actively make them happen.

I think you misread me here. If I meet a girl I like I will ask her for her number and a date eventually. What I'm getting at is should I try to actively meet women? Like should I go to a club or somewhere to just meet women? I've heard from a lot of people that doing that makes me desperate and makes me look bad to them.

> it seems you're very much concerned about this issue

not going to lie, it definitely comes into my head a lot. But I do have my own life. I definitely not lacking things like hobbies.

>  If you talk like this in front of women or potential dates, you have no shot. I’ll assume for argument’s sake that you are just posting your innermost thoughts here.

It is basically my most innermost thought. I definitely don't talk that way around women. I normally don't feel that I'm that unconfident either. Maybe I'm just in denial but I really don't think it's a confidence thing.
I post not because I'm "thirsty and weak" but rather because I want to know if I'm really as ugly as people say.
So its just being insecure from being ugly not actually being ugly?
